subject: reasoning
question: Pari starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards south. She then takes a left turn, drives 10 km, turns right and drives 5 km. She then takes a right turn and drives 7 km. She takes a final right turn, drives 17 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should she drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Pari starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards south.

She then takes a left turn, drives 10 km, turns right and drives 5 km.

She then takes a right turn and drives 7 km.

She takes a final right turn, drives 17 km and stops at Point P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b5e4f3fadb1417fc05531a30202e2734d5d4815dfa60be6e5f68bcac4ee4160.png] 

So, She should drive **3 km towards west** in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
